svg.title: Learning
svg.desc: Everything that can happen to a market event. The main line runs straight down through concrete steps and yes/no checks; a step that runs only sometimes sits to the right of its check and rejoins the line. Learning stages the event in two parts, working memory and then long-term memory; a person then checks every change to both, including the second- and third-order ripple, and only what they approve is committed. Inference reads committed versions and never writes.

svg.text: Something that happened and was published: news, a data release, a filing, or an imported item. Its
publication time decides the day it is folded in.
One dated piece of research in an import bundle, already read and categorized by a research agent. Importing
One change: add or retire an item, change or observe a value, group or dissolve a superentity.
The operations one market event stands for, with the evidence behind them.
Anything in the graph: an entity (an actor or an idea), a subentity (one of its values), an interaction (a
causal link), or a superentity (a recurring group).
